description:
WSJT-X implements amateur radio communication protocols or "modes" called FT4, FT8, JT4,
JT9, JT65, QRA64, ISCAT, MSK144, and WSPR, as well as one called Echo for detecting and
measuring your own radio signals reflected from the Moon. These modes were all designed
for making reliable, confirmed QSOs under extreme weak-signal conditions.
